verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's documented Payments/Verification/Data APIs operate on UK/EU account identifiers (sort code/account number, IBAN, Direct Debit, Faster Payments, VRPs) and provide identity/name verification, not US-style ACH funding via account/routing numbers or tokenized ACH equivalents. No evidence pack item references ACH, routing numbers, or micro-deposit-free bank-debit tokenization.
